messages:

Date: 2026-03-28T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Quick product walkthrough request

Hi Monica / Redwood team,

I signed up through the self-serve trial and would like a short walkthrough to evaluate Redwood for our inference tier. I'm the engineering lead for integrations at Dynaworks — we run most traffic out of Mexico City (CST).

Prefer sometime next week after 10am CST. Would like the AE + an SE on the call and our IT/security lead (Leah) included for a quick compliance overview.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendez
Engineering Lead, Dynaworks

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough request — proposing slots

Hi Carlos — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I'm the SDR on this account; looping in Ava (AE) and Dylan (SE) to pick a time.

Ava/Dylan — can you join a 45-minute product walkthrough that covers: 1) quick product tour, 2) example latency & cost numbers for a 4GB context, 3) security/compliance touchpoints (Leah will chime in)?

Carlos / Leah, proposed slots (all listed with conversions):
- Tue 2026-03-30 • 11:00 AM CST / 9:00 AM PDT / 17:00 BST
- Wed 2026-03-31 • 2:00 PM CST / 12:00 PM PDT / 20:00 BST
- Thu 2026-04-01 • 10:00 AM CST / 8:00 AM PDT / 16:00 BST

If none of those work, tell us two windows that do and we'll re-run a quick poll. Draft agenda attached.

Agenda (attached: agenda-draft.pdf) — 45 min
- 5 min intros
- 15 min product walkthrough (AE)
- 15 min technical deep-dive (SE)
- 10 min security + next steps

Thanks,
Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129
Attachment: agenda-draft.pdf (1 page)
From: Leah Price <leah.price@dynaworks.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-29T15:30:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick product walkthrough request — security notes and timing constraints

Hi all — thanks for including me. A couple quick notes from security:
- We prefer sessions later in our day (post-16:00 BST) so our infra/security engineers can join live.
- Before deep technical demos, can you share SOC 2 scope and any summary of where customer logs / KV caches may be stored? A short artifact or bullet list is fine.

Proposed alternate slots (BST / CST / PDT):
- Tue 2026-03-30 • 17:00 BST / 11:00 CST / 9:00 PDT (this matches one of Monica's suggestions and works for us)
- Thu 2026-04-01 • 18:00 BST / 12:00 CST / 10:00 PDT

If you can share a one-pager or quick doc with SOC2 scope and where we can expect logs to land, that will help us prep. I've attached our internal security point-of-contact list for scheduling (security-contacts.xlsx).

Best,
Leah Price
Head of IT & Security, Dynaworks
leah.price@dynaworks.com
Attachment: security-contacts.xlsx
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Thanks Leah — very helpful. Dylan and I can swing the 2026-03-30 11:00 AM CST slot (that's Tue 17:00 BST). To make the main session efficient, two quick asks:
1) Leah — would you prefer a 15-minute pre-call with Dylan (SE) the morning of the session to cover any high-priority security questions? We can do a short sync so the 45-minute walkthrough stays focused.
2) Carlos — can you confirm the preferred slot from the list below or propose one alternate?

Confirmed candidate slots (converted):
- Tue 2026-03-30 • 11:00 AM CST / 9:00 AM PDT / 17:00 BST (preferred by security)
- Thu 2026-04-01 • 10:00 AM CST / 8:00 AM PDT / 16:00 BST

Thanks,
Ava Chen

ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
